title: spiraea yatabei subf. latifolia
intro: Spiraea yatabei subf. latifolia, commonly known as Japanese meadowsweet, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiraea yatabei subf. latifolia include relieving pain, reducing fever, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
